questions.question: What is JavaScript mainly used for?

correct.title: Correct! 🎉
correct.details: JavaScript is primarily used to make web pages interactive. It can respond to user actions, update content dynamically, and communicate with servers.

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details: JavaScript is primarily used to make web pages interactive. It can respond to user actions, update content dynamically, and communicate with servers.

questions.question: Which keyword creates a variable that can be changed?

correct.title: Correct! 🎉
correct.details: let creates a variable that can be reassigned later. const creates a constant that cannot be changed after initialization.

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
wrong.details: let creates a variable that can be reassigned later. const creates a constant that cannot be changed after initialization.

questions.question: What shows output in the browser console?

correct.details: console.log() displays information in the browser's console, which is useful for debugging and testing code.

questions.question: Which is NOT a valid variable name?

correct.details: Variable names cannot start with numbers. They must start with a letter, underscore (_), or dollar sign ($).

wrong.title: Not quite! 🤔
